data: What is the maximum value of goodness-of-fit score for N400 size for any LM?

The maximum value of the goodness-of-fit score for N400 size for any LM can be found in the top left graph. The y-axis represents the goodness-of-fit score, and the x-axis represents the average log probability. The highest point on the y-axis corresponds to the maximum value of the goodness-of-fit score. By visually inspecting the graph, we can see that the maximum value of the goodness-of-fit score for N400 size for any LM is approximately 60.
